published_reference: Fast4DReg JCS 2023 Fig. S1A / Pylvanainen thesis Table 7
derivation: Frames 0 and 6; complete Z; frame-0 max-Z template matching maps the archived Fiji overlap crop into the raw image; a central 160-pixel-high Fiji ROI with its full X extent and a corresponding raw Y ROI with 16-pixel margin are stored. The raw X dimension remains the full 416 pixels. Because Y is cropped, XY drift estimated from this fixture is NOT Fiji's full-field estimate; tests take XY from the full-field XY fixture. No resampling or intensity normalization is applied
fiji_frame6_translation_method: Recovered from the archived Fiji output (not a Fiji drift table): Nelder-Mead fit of the Fiji two-pass ImageJ 1.53t bicubic translation of raw frame 6, rounded once to uint16, to archived Fiji frame 6. At the optimum 99.99% of voxels are identical and the maximum difference is 1 grey level; changing any component by 0.005 px lowers the identical fraction to 37-69%.
published_drift_convention: Drift_generator.ijm copies frame 0 unchanged and adds (x,y,z)=published[t] to frame t>=1. The published frame-0 value is generated noise that was never applied. Translation to apply = -published[t] (0 for frame 0). Confirmed by fitting raw frame 6 to a translated raw frame 0: displacement (z,y,x)=(-2.4792,-2.0125,4.8259).
